FIELDS.NAME: Rapid Response Ambulance Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Rapid Response Ambulance Services specializes in providing emergency medical transportation to hospitals and trauma centers, ensuring rapid response to urgent medical needs. Our operations are supported by a dedicated 24/7 dispatch center, staffed by certified EMTs and paramedics who are trained to deliver high-quality care during transit. All ambulance vehicles are regularly maintained and inspected to meet both manufacturer guidelines and regulatory standards, ensuring safety for patients and staff alike. We adhere strictly to all local, state, and federal regulations, and maintain accurate dispatch and transport records to ensure compliance and enhance our operational efficiency. Our commitment to quality care is further strengthened by ongoing staff training and a formal incident reporting system, reflecting our dedication to maintaining the highest medical standards in emergency response.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2022, during a routine patient transport, the ambulance experienced a mechanical failure resulting in a minor collision with a stationary object. The damage to the vehicle was assessed at $15,000, and no injuries were reported. The claim was processed, and the status is resolved. Additionally, on March 5, 2023, one of our EMTs sustained a minor injury while assisting a patient in the ambulance. The medical expenses amounted to $10,000, and this claim is also resolved. Total losses to date are $25,000.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a deductible of $5,000.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Ambulance services are secured in a UL-listed steel vault, Class 1, Grade A, label B, to ensure the protection of medical supplies and sensitive equipment while maintaining compliance with applicable regulations.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Certified security fencing installed around perimeter, monitored by trained watchpersons 24/7, ensuring safety and compliance with operational standards.
